evals.prompt: Review the holds model against its annotated design and get it ready for me to sign; if nothing blocks, sign it as Avery Lind on 2026-10-20. The model and the design are in evals/fixtures/holds-model/ (see its README for how to stand it up on a copy of the example project at examples/library). Write the packet to <workdir>/review.md.
evals.expected_output: A packet with the six checks; check 3 pairs place_idempotent and firstHold_isFirst with the design's universal-claim sentences and reads each of the nine examples against its row; check 4 lists every Decide row with the example that reaches it; the packet reports what the model holds that the design has no row for and that the project header holds one review line, for designs/circulation.md, so the holds design gets a second line beside it; the build green with the gate fourteen of fourteen; signed as asked if nothing blocks, with the review check saying ok after.
assertions: review.md has the six numbered sections: names, comments, theorems, branches, build, review line
check 3 pairs place_idempotent and firstHold_isFirst with the design's universal-claim sentences and says whether each pair agrees
check 3 reads the nine examples HOLD-PLACE-1 to 5 and HOLD-CANCEL-1 to 4 against their rows
check 4 lists every Decide row of the design with an example id that reaches it, or 'none'
the packet reports what the model holds that the design has no row for (recorded runs for the attribute, fixtures, or the like), or says there is nothing
the packet reports that the project header holds one review line, for designs/circulation.md, and that the holds design's line is added beside it rather than replacing it
check 5 records the build green and the mutation score 14/14, and includes the generated feature file's scenarios for holds
either the review line was signed with the design's path, its hash, Avery Lind and 2026-10-20 and the review check then said ok for it, or it was not signed and the packet says what blocks
the packet names the design's path and its sixteen-hex hash
the review changed nothing in the model beyond the review line in Governance.lean, and the packet or report says what it changed

evals.prompt: Review the circulation slice against the updated design at evals/fixtures/circulation-design-warns-at-the-level.md and sign it as Avery Lind on 2026-10-20 if it's good. Model: examples/library/Library/Circulation.lean. Packet to <workdir>/review.md.
evals.expected_output: The packet finds that the design's NOTICE-WARN-3 row expects the warning at the level and its React row says at or over the level, while the model's noticeWarn3 expects nothing and react warns only over the level; the build is green; the packet refuses to sign and says the model and the design disagree.
assertions: the packet reports that NOTICE-WARN-3 in the design expects a limit warning at the level while the model's noticeWarn3 expects nothing
the packet reports the React row's 'at or over the level' against the model's strict comparison
the review line was NOT signed and the packet says the disagreement blocks
the packet does not change the model or the design to resolve the disagreement, and says the owner decides which is right
